**Severity:** error · **Area:** Styles (`RV5xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
css``: unterminated comment
```

```text
css``: unterminated string
```

```text
css``: unclosed block
```

```text
css``: unexpected }
```

```text
css``: expected a rule, found {text:?}
```

```text
css``: use :global(selector); bare :global is not supported
```

```text
css``: unbalanced {char}
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Fix the CSS syntax inside the css`` block (close braces, strings and comments; write `:global(selector)`).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { css } from "@rivetjs/runtime/css";
const s = css`.a { color: red`;
```

```tsx prefer
import { css } from "@rivetjs/runtime/css";
const s = css`.a { color: red }`;
```

## When it is reported

Only with the styles option (build); check op passes styles: None so never in editor.
